business.name: Sobot
business.sells: WhatsApp broadcasts, chatbots and shared inbox for growing Indian SMB and mid-market brands (not large enterprises, banks or conglomerates, which build in-house)
buyers: not large enterprises, banks or conglomerate-owned retailers
business.trigger_moment: They start pushing customers to WhatsApp and one phone can no longer keep up.

signals_to_watch.look_for: brand starts taking orders, bookings or leads over WhatsApp
signals_to_watch.query: brand launches WhatsApp ordering customers India

signals_to_watch.look_for: public complaints about, or a switch away from, Wati, Interakt or Gupshup
signals_to_watch.query: Wati Interakt Gupshup review switching pricing

signals_to_watch.look_for: D2C, edtech or clinic hiring a CRM, retention or WhatsApp marketing role
signals_to_watch.query: hiring CRM retention manager D2C brand

signals_to_watch.look_for: founder or team posting about drowning in customer WhatsApp messages
signals_to_watch.query: small business overwhelmed WhatsApp customer messages

signals_to_watch.look_for: brand announcing a big Diwali or sale-season campaign
signals_to_watch.query: D2C brand Diwali sale campaign announces

signals_to_watch.look_for: D2C, edtech or healthtech raising seed or Series A
signals_to_watch.query: D2C brand raises Series A India

signals_to_watch.look_for: brand opening new cities, stores, centres or clinics
signals_to_watch.query: D2C brand opens new stores cities

signals_to_watch.look_for: brands moving from SMS to WhatsApp after TRAI SMS rules or Meta pricing changes
signals_to_watch.query: brands shift from SMS to WhatsApp
